outputs.Decision_and_explanation: FAIL: The top sub-plot is a box plot showing median line, box and whiskers for total polyp number per mouse, but the caption only states sample sizes and significance levels (n=8-18 per genotype; *P<0.05; ***P<0.001) without defining what the box, median line or whiskers represent (e.g., IQR, min/max, percentiles).

FAIL: The bar chart quantifying GTP-bound Rac1/Cdc42 displays error bars, but the caption does not state whether these represent SD, SEM, CI or another measure of variability, nor the number of replicates.

FAIL: The bar chart of relative expression (Asef, pJNK1, MMP9) includes error bars, but the caption gives no definition of what these bars represent (e.g., SD, SEM) or the number of independent replicates.
